correctness.rationale: The rank-three orbit multisets are reconstructed from permissible-pair relations t³=t, e²=e, te=et=e; Euler-series bounds yield limsup at most sqrt(zeta(3)/2). Pigeonhole grouping of H distinct cycle types of sizes L..2L produces at least n³ nonisomorphic same-size fibers, permitting r3 >= n^(2 floor(n/s)) and liminf >= 1/648. All rank-two orbits are within the no-two-cycle multiset family, whose logarithmic count is O(n/log n); therefore r2/r3 vanishes. Exact coefficients were independently computed through n=40. Boundary n>=5 and semigroup-not-monoid convention were checked.

value.rationale: The primary structural authors explicitly pose asymptotic growth of the minimum generating rank. The distinct infinite-family Theta(n/sqrt(log n)) logarithmic law and rigorous dominance of rank-three generator orbits answer a substantive fraction of that open direction. The lower argument builds exponentially many forced equal-size fiber types; the upper uses nontrivial analytic estimates. It is not a finite recomputation or routine parameter variation.
